items.summary: In both manifests only ownership.mjs and audit-ownership.mjs changed; checks.mjs, the libraries and every other key are byte-identical to ca3179b3c^. ownership.mjs keeps targetDigestDrift and its raw predicate unchanged. When drift is non-empty, it calls `python3 -B rebind.py --check` and builds an authenticated set from authenticatedSupersededOrigins (keyed on originBinding) and authenticatedIdenticalUnitGroups. It then partitions the raw rows into accounted and unaccounted by the exact key (file, claimId, targetOwner, targetAnchor, targetUnitDigest). That is set membership only, so no matching logic is copied into JavaScript. The script fails closed on a spawn error, an exit other than 0 or 1, or malformed JSON. audit-ownership.mjs swaps only !targetDigestDrift.length for !unaccountedTargetDigestDrift.length, and both duplicate and new-pair checks stay. rebind.py adds claimId and originBinding to superseded entries and a groups list, filtered by its unchanged matches(), which requires every member to match. verify.py additionally asserts that accounted plus unaccounted is a multiset partition of the raw rows, and it now also requires noNewDoubleOwnership to be true. test-accounting.py removes only its print line. Both receipt negative controls hold, and so do my three independent variants. Low: the verify.py comment that live target drift must have an exact recorded rebind now applies only to the 127 overlay rows. The 23 audit rows are judged by rebind --check, per L13-27; the module docstring says so.
